### data/package read in
```{r}
set.seed(1)

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(naniar)
library(brms)
library(tidybayes)
library(viridis)
library(cowplot)

# Data for poisson model 
poisson_model_data <- readRDS("data_for_poisson.rds")
# Example Poisson model
pois_mod <- readRDS('pois_mod.Rds')
# Data for weighted zero inflated beta regression
zi_model_data <- read_rds(file = "zi_model_data.Rds")
# Example weighted zero inflated beta regression
dummy_zi_beta_model <- readRDS("zi_beta_model.RDS")

```

### Functions
```{r}
# plotting function
theme_arwain <- function () { 
  theme(
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill="transparent", colour=NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill="transparent", colour=NA), 
    legend.background = element_rect(fill="transparent", colour=NA),
    legend.key = element_rect(fill="transparent", colour=NA),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour="#dedede", size=0.5),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour="#dedede", size=0.5),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = NA, fill = "transparent"),
    strip.text.x = element_text(),
    strip.text.y = element_text(),
    strip.background = element_rect(colour=NA, fill="transparent"),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(2, "lines"),
    text=element_text(family="Times", size = 14),
    plot.title=element_text(size=14),
  )
}

# get summary for poisson model posterior draws
compute_summary <- function(x) {
  c(mean = mean(x),
    lower = quantile(x, 0.025),
    upper = quantile(x, 0.975),
    se_res = sd(x)/sqrt(length(x))) # sample level se of posteriors
}
```


### poisson priors from Vass et al. 2026
```{R}
custom_priors_highvar <- c(
  set_prior('normal(0, 5)', class = 'b', nlpar = 'interaction'), 
  set_prior('normal(0, 5)', class = 'b', nlpar = 'main'),
  set_prior("normal(10, 1)", class = "sd", nlpar = "interaction"),
  set_prior("normal(10, 1)", class = "sd", nlpar = "main")
)
```

### run poisson model - 
### this is modified from Vass et al. 2026 to incorporate right censored counts 
### (e.g. >1 or >100).
```{R}
### approx 15min runtime, AMD Ryzen 9 7950X 4.5Ghz, 16 core cpu, 32GB RAM
pois_mod <- brm(bf(
    Count | cens(censor) ~ main + am * log_inv_logit(interaction), 
    main ~ offset(log_dilution) + (1|sample_id), 
    interaction ~ (1|sample_id),
    nl = TRUE
  ),
  data = poisson_model_data, 
  family = poisson(link = "log"), 
  prior = custom_priors_highvar,
  # half n. draws within example
  warmup = 4000, iter = 8000, chains = 4, cores = 4,
  silent = FALSE)


summary(pois_mod)


```

### Estimate likelihood of AMR in AMR -ve samples from Poisson draws. 
```{R}
# data used in poisson model
dummy_data <- pois_mod$data
dummy_data$sample_id <- factor(dummy_data$sample_id,
                                       levels = levels(pois_mod$data$sample_id)) 

# get sample level posterior draws for estimated AMR prop.
dummy_propres <- as_tibble(fitted(pois_mod,
                                 re_formula = NULL,
                                 summary = F,
                                 nlpar = "interaction")) 

# back transform logit scaled proportions
dummy_propres_trans <- as_tibble(inv_logit_scaled(dummy_propres))

# posterior means, CIs and SE's for each sample
dummy_propres_summary <- apply(dummy_propres_trans, 2, compute_summary)

# transpose to long format
dummy_propres_summary_df <- as.data.frame(t(dummy_propres_summary))

# set threshold for draws
# numerically lower threshold = more res bacteria required for a draw to be AMR 
# +ve. 
dummy_propres_likelihood_1000 <- dummy_propres_trans %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(. > 0.001, 1, 0))) 

# get posterior means (proportion of draws > threshold)
dummy_propres_likelihood_1000 <-  colMeans(dummy_propres_likelihood_1000)
dummy_propres_likelihood_1000_df <- as.data.frame(dummy_propres_likelihood_1000)

# attach sample identifiers
dummy_interaction_with_counts_1000 <- cbind(dummy_data, 
                                            dummy_propres_summary_df, 
                                            dummy_propres_likelihood_1000_df)

# Poisson model estimates only used for AMR negative samples (where count for am
# == 1 is 0). 
amnegative <- dummy_interaction_with_counts_1000 %>%
  filter(am == 1 & Count == 0) %>%
  pull(sample_id)

am_negative_dummy_interaction_with_counts_1000 <- dummy_interaction_with_counts_1000 %>%
  filter(sample_id %in% amnegative) %>%
  filter(am == 0 & Count > 0)

# calculate weights - down weight uncertain samples. 

# get max weight for normalizing
max_weight_1000 <- max(
  am_negative_dummy_interaction_with_counts_1000 %>%
    filter(am == 0) %>%
    mutate(weight = log(1/se_res)) %>%
    pull(weight))

# log transform inverse variance weights in weiht_adj 
am_negative_dummy_interaction_with_counts_weight_1000 <- am_negative_dummy_interaction_with_counts_1000 %>%
  filter(am == 0) %>%
  mutate(weight_adj = log(1/se_res)/max_weight_1000,
         weight = 1/se_res)

### data frame of amr -ve samples with weights and 
dummy_likelihoods_and_weights <- 
  am_negative_dummy_interaction_with_counts_weight_1000 %>%
  rename("amr_likelihood" = "dummy_propres_likelihood_1000") %>%
  select(sample_id, amr_likelihood, weight_adj)
```

### Join estimated AMR likelihood to sample metadata
```{R}

# join amr negative likelihoods and weights
zi_model_data <- zi_model_data %>% 
  left_join(dummy_likelihoods_and_weights)

zi_model_data <- zi_model_data %>%
  # assign likelihood of 1 to AMR +ve samples
  mutate(amr_likelihood = ifelse(is.na(amr_likelihood), 1, 
                                 amr_likelihood),
         # assign weight of 1 to AMR +ve samples
         weight_adj = ifelse(is.na(weight_adj), 1, 
                                 weight_adj),
         # inverse likelihoods for ZI modelling
         zi_amr_likelihood = ifelse(amr_likelihood == 1, 0, 
                                 1 - amr_likelihood))

```

### priors for beta regression
```{R}
# hosrshoes priors on fixed/population effects. 
zi_priors <- c(set_prior("student_t(3, 0, 2.5)", class = "Intercept"),
                   set_prior("horseshoe(3)", class = "b"),
                   set_prior("logistic(0,1)", class = "Intercept", dpar ="zi"),
                   set_prior("horseshoe(3)", class = "b", dpar = "zi"))
```

### model formula:

```{R}
# mirrored formulae for mean and zi terms
zi_beta_formula <- bf(
  zi_amr_likelihood | weights(weight_adj) ~ 
    1 + species + age_group + location_group +
    t2(CLIMATE_mean_temp_7, CLIMATE_mean_humid_7_scaled, bs = "tp", by = location_group) +
    s(day_of_study, bs = "tp", by = species) +
    (1|visit_id) + (1|vet_id) + (1|farm),
  
  zi ~ 1 + species + age_group + location_group +
    t2(CLIMATE_mean_temp_7, CLIMATE_mean_humid_7_scaled, bs = "tp", by = location_group) +
    s(day_of_study, bs = "tp", by = species) +
    (1|visit_id) + (1|vet_id) + (1|farm)
)

```

```{R}
# format model data for weighted ZI beta regression
zi_model_data <- zi_model_data %>%
  distinct(sample_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    day_of_study = as.numeric(day_of_study),
    visit_id = as.factor(visit_id),
    vet_id = as.factor(vet_id),
    age_group = as.factor(age_group),
    location_group = as.factor(location_group),
    species = as.factor(species),
    farm = as.factor(farm)
  ) %>%
  select(sample_id, amr_binary, zi_amr_likelihood, weight_adj, am_free_numeric,
         farm, vet_id, visit_id, species, age_group, location_group, day_of_study,
         CLIMATE_mean_temp_7, CLIMATE_mean_humid_7_scaled)  %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  filter(am_free_numeric > 0) %>%
  mutate(day_of_study = scale(day_of_study))

# zi beta regression
dummy_zi_beta_model <- brm(zi_beta_formula,
                  data = zi_model_data,
                  family = zero_inflated_beta(),
                  prior = zi_priors,
                  backend = "cmdstanr",
                  adapt_delta = 0.99,
                  warmup = 1000, iter = 2000, chains = 4, cores=4) 


summary(dummy_zi_beta_model)
```

### demonstration plot - visualising modelled splines across the range of 
### temperatures observed.
```{R}

# create dummy data set with range of temperatures between min and max observed.
# indoor samples.
dummy_temperature <- expand.grid(
  species = NA,
  age_group = NA,
  location_group = "indoor",
  CLIMATE_mean_humid_7_scaled = mean(zi_model_data$CLIMATE_mean_humid_7_scaled, na.rm = TRUE),
  CLIMATE_mean_temp_7 = seq(
    min(zi_model_data$CLIMATE_mean_temp_7, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(zi_model_data$CLIMATE_mean_temp_7, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 100
  ),
  day_of_study = mean(zi_model_data$day_of_study, na.rm = TRUE)
)

# posterior draw df
temp <- as_tibble(fitted(
  dummy_zi_beta_model,
  newdata = dummy_temperature,
  re_formula = NA,
  summary = FALSE
))

### randomly select 800 spline estimates
estimates_splines_800 <- temp[sample(1:nrow(temp), 800), ]

# attach and backtransform temperatures
estimates_splines_800_tidy <- as_tibble(t(estimates_splines_800)) %>%
  mutate(change_var = dummy_temperature$CLIMATE_mean_temp_7) %>%
  gather(key = 'spline', value = 'estimate', -change_var) %>%
  mutate(temperature = change_var * 
           attr(zi_model_data$CLIMATE_mean_temp_7, "scaled:scale") + 
           attr(zi_model_data$CLIMATE_mean_temp_7, "scaled:center"))


# get posterior summaries for each temperature
estimates_summary <- as_tibble(fitted(dummy_zi_beta_model,
                                      newdata = dummy_temperature,
                                      re_formula = NA,
                                      summary = T))


results <- cbind(estimates_summary, dummy_temperature)%>%
  distinct() 

# attach and backtransform temperatures
results <- results %>%
  rename('change_var' = CLIMATE_mean_temp_7) %>%
  mutate(model = "ZI") %>%
  mutate(temperature = change_var * 
           attr(zi_model_data$CLIMATE_mean_temp_7, "scaled:scale") + 
           attr(zi_model_data$CLIMATE_mean_temp_7, "scaled:center"))


# build histogram showing observations and binary amr status
indoor_temp_hist <- zi_model_data %>%
  filter(location_group == "indoor") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = CLIMATE_mean_temp_7 * 
               attr(CLIMATE_mean_temp_7, "scaled:scale") +
               attr(CLIMATE_mean_temp_7, "scaled:center"),
             fill = as.factor(amr_binary))) +
  geom_histogram(position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = viridis(2)[1],   
                               "1" = viridis(2)[2])) + 
  theme_arwain() +
  xlab("Temperature (°C)")  +
  ylab("Court") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none")

# plot splines
indoor_amox_temp <- estimates_splines_800_tidy %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_line(aes(x = temperature, y = 1-estimate, group = spline), 
            colour = '#C98BE0', alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(data = results, aes(x = temperature, y = 1-Estimate), 
            colour = 'black', linewidth = 1.5) +
  theme_arwain() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_line(color = "#c9c9c9",
                                  linewidth = 0.5)) +
  xlab("Temperature (°C)") +
  ylab('Likelihood of resistance') +
  ylim(0, 1) 

# join plots
indoor_amox_temp <- plot_grid(indoor_temp_hist, indoor_amox_temp,
                        ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.25, 1))  

indoor_amox_temp

# get min and max temperatures
min_row <- dummy_temperature[which.min(dummy_temperature$CLIMATE_mean_temp_7), ]
max_row <- dummy_temperature[which.max(dummy_temperature$CLIMATE_mean_temp_7), ]

minmax_temp_rows <- rbind(min_row, max_row)

# fit model on min and max temperatures
minmax_estimates <- as_tibble(fitted(dummy_zi_beta_model,
                                     newdata = minmax_temp_rows,
                                     re_formula = NA,
                                     summary = F))

# quantify fold change in posterior likelihoods/CIs
indoor_amox_temp_minmax <- minmax_estimates %>%
  mutate(min_temp = 1-V1,
         max_temp = 1-V2) %>%
  mutate(foldchange = max_temp/min_temp) %>%
  summarise(median_foldchange = median(foldchange),
            lwr2_5 = quantile(foldchange, 0.025),
            upr97_5 = quantile(foldchange, 0.975),
            lwr5 = quantile(foldchange, 0.05),
            upr95 = quantile(foldchange, 0.95),
            lwr25 = quantile(foldchange, 0.25),
            upr75 = quantile(foldchange, 0.75)) %>%
  mutate(location = "indoor")

indoor_amox_temp_minmax

```
